tailLossBehavior: The one-key release requires the exact installed v2 anchor, complete immutable baseline, current SQL registered local operations, and a genuine Account-aborted first-NEW source or a distinct authenticated never-admitted negative terminal. The final source-kind argument selects capacity-only negative cleanup; it never creates an admitting binding. It writes only the SQL-issued RELEASED reservation bytes, removes only that operation's exact original binding field, and atomically advances the partition-local opaque physical revision. The terminal V2 value retains its original reservation coverage tuple and installed anchor; its inventoryRevision is the frozen SQL release-preparation source revision P. A later durable SQL receipt advances the current inventory clock to fresh revision R and links P, exact postimage, independent readback, and the original operation. Missing baseline/header/revision, legacy or malformed values, unknown fields, conflicting or newer members, wrong reservation/anchor/incarnation, or changed source fail closed. RELEASE_PENDING remains capacity-counted until exact readback and guarded SQL completion; a completed RELEASED capacity remains in the bounded physical projection until exact original-operation retirement. The physical revision rejects a stale prepared release after retirement. No coverage acknowledgement, barrier, or admission authority is produced.
